title: Jazz resurgence and the ambassadors
summary: He expects the effort to spread worldwide, with jazz in its highest resurgence.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Quiet as it's kept now, believe me, I think by this being what it is, where it is, and what it's about, it's going
to trigger off like you wouldn't believe. We can open another frontier, a whole new frontier. It's going to have some effect around the world. I seriously believe that.
You remember when Dave Brubeck wrote a piece called 'The Real Ambassadors'?
It's still going on and apparently you're becoming one of the new ambassadors, in ways that you might not have thought about 20 years ago.

Well, I hope now that I can give of myself and I know that I worked very hard to, made a lot of sacrifices, to give of myself. But you know, sometimes one of the hardest things in the world is to give somebody something. Trying to give...It's hard to give sometimes. That period in my life... I feel good about it, because I know things now...It's happening and the motion is going right for it.

There is a future to what we are doing. If something happened to me tomorrow and I pass on, it'll continue. It won't stop. The motion has gotten started, and it won't stop. I don't think they can take it away from us now; I don't think they want to. And I think the ones that I'm trying to reach with an open mind, whether they're there or whoever's there now, that open mind is there.

I think the time is right and it's ready and it's going to prove itself. It's going to be good and it's going to go right along with the trend because jazz now is in its highest resurgence in history. So, our tomorrow is OK. We don't have to worry about the tomorrow. The young people in the colleges and schools, even the high schools, they've gotten more involved with it than ever in the past.
So all these people in the industry and in the system, we don't have to worry about if it's going to last until tomorrow. Tomorrow's OK. Let's get it together today. Tomorrow is being taken care of.
